tools.name: start_lookahead
tools.title: Start two-week lookahead
tools.description: Begin a PM two-week lookahead review. Returns the intake instructions.

tools.name: submit_lookahead
tools.title: Submit lookahead
tools.description: Check a two-week lookahead before analysis. Nothing is stored; pass the same text to later tools.

lookahead.description: The two-week lookahead as plain text (max 20,000 characters).

tools.name: get_questions
tools.title: Get clarifying questions
tools.description: Get the clarifying questions for one stage of the lookahead review, in order: crews, materials, inspections, rfis, submittals, weather, predecessors.

stage.description: Stage to get questions for; defaults to the first stage.

tools.name: submit_answers
tools.title: Submit answers
tools.description: Check answers to the clarifying questions before analysis. Nothing is stored; pass the same answers to later tools.

answers.description: Answers to the clarifying questions (max 10,000 characters).

tools.name: run_gap_analysis
tools.title: Run gap analysis
tools.description: Find gaps in a two-week lookahead: missing predecessors, open submittals and RFIs, unscheduled inspections, lead-time risks and manpower conflicts.

lookahead.description: The two-week lookahead as plain text (max 20,000 characters).

answers.description: Answers to the clarifying questions (max 10,000 characters).

tools.name: build_hit_list
tools.title: Build hit list
tools.description: Turn a two-week lookahead into a prioritized action list, each with an owner and due date.

lookahead.description: The two-week lookahead as plain text (max 20,000 characters).

answers.description: Answers to the clarifying questions (max 10,000 characters).
